name: shun126/DungeonGenerator
description: A procedural 3D dungeon generator Unreal Engine 5 plugin that creates levels, mini-maps, and mission graphs for roguelike games. Supports runtime generation with Blueprint integration and automatic room connectivity.
score_rationale: The leading open-source UE5 dungeon generation plugin with mission graph support and Blueprint-friendly API.
summary: UE5 plugin generating procedural dungeons with mission graphs and Blueprint integration.
